humanAuthorization: 就按这个方案推进，把优先级同步给导师、实现和评测会话，先交付一个端到端跑通、反馈可信、正常退出的冻结版本，提分和效率优化放到后续迭代。
goal: 先交付明确支持范围内端到端跑通、反馈可信、正常退出且可复现的冻结版本。

currentDeliveryTarget.humanInstruction: 让导师明确正常任务、故障闭环和单例 benchmark 的实际启动安排及交付时间，争取今天14点前完成首包。有阻断及时说明，继续只处理交付阻断，不扩大范围。
requiredScheduleFields: normal actual or planned start and closure
fault actual or planned start and closure
single benchmark actual or planned start and official scoring closure
independent review and frozen delivery time
currentDeliveryTarget.blockerReporting: Promptly state evidence, smallest in-scope repair, effect on the14:00target and next concrete checkpoint; distinguish actual starts from estimates.
currentDeliveryTarget.forecastWithdrawn: 15:05 depended on A success, contradicted by031 actual failure; replan after12:50concrete design

scopePolicy.runtimeFailureMeans: Known blocking hangs, crashes, misleading PASS or unfinished process closure in the declared scope; legitimate defect feedback is expected behavior.

acceptance.normal: One real normal task completes all applicable original checks without clear false findings, false PASS or abnormal process closure.
acceptance.fault: One real fault control produces source-grounded actionable feedback, actually delivers it to the business agent, observes repair and freshly verifies the current artifact.
acceptance.benchmark: At least one fixed benchmark case on the same frozen candidate actually exits normally, produces a frozen prediction and completes unchanged official scoring. An unresolved task may still be a valid completed run; timeout partial artifacts do not satisfy this gate.
acceptance.integrity: Necessary engineering and actual host/environment checks apply to the exact evaluated artifact; source snapshot, hashes, commands, raw evidence, limitations and independent verdict are delivered together.
acceptance.claimedScope: Only the declared host/configuration and exercised scenarios; no blanket claim that all plugin scenarios are proven.

deferredUntilAfterFirstAcceptedFrozenDel: expanded sample screening or benchmark coverage
